g.title: cluster_legend_state
g.text: a state: what it runs, top to bottom

g.title: f0__start__0
g.text: The sha256 of the milestone body, which the run never writes, so a change is an operator's edit.

g.title: f0__complete__0
g.text: Whether the milestone body still matches *baseline*, and every work-list row not yet done.

g.title: f0__fill__0
g.text: File every item of *kind* the planning graph holds, satisfied ones as done, skipping ids already filed.

g.title: f0__split_epics__1
g.text: Whether the approved milestone already has a valid ordered epic split.

g.title: f0__split_epics__1->f0__fill__0
g.text: the milestone has an ordered split

g.title: f0__start__1
g.text: Each epic's seed ids and story slugs as the run found them, for the reconcile gate to measure drops against.

g.title: f0__start__2
g.text: Register ONE register record as a new story inside an already-existing epic.

g.title: f0__start__3
g.text: A story's services stay inside the sorted union of the services of the seeds it covers.

g.title: f0__start__5
g.text: Close the record a story was authored from as promoted, naming the story and its epic.

g.title: f1__start__0
g.text: Capture the graph and story-body baseline an edit is allowed to change.

g.title: f1__apply_plan__0
g.text: Apply one validated plan idempotently through Ostler's structural APIs.

g.title: f1__apply_plan__1
g.text: Prove disk matches the approved graph and unaffected story bodies remain byte-stable.

g.title: f1__finish__0
g.text: `ostler doctor` over the whole graph, as a blocking gate.

g.title: f1__rewrite_epic__0
g.text: Rewrite epic prose after an approved graph edit

g.title: f1__check_coverage__0
g.text: Every seed covered by a story, the story graph acyclic, every story file present.

g.title: f1__design_mockup__0
g.text: Design a mockup for a new screen: `{{ workhorse_var('story_slug') }}`

g.title: f1__design_mockup__1
g.text: A story needs a mockup exactly when one of its services is a UI book.

g.title: f1__next_affected_story__0
g.text: Resolve the next approved affected story without widening the edit worklist.

g.title: f1__finish__1
g.text: Commit the epic/story docs this run wrote, in the one repo it wrote them in.

g.title: f1__finish__2
g.text: Close the record a story was authored from as promoted, naming the story and its epic.

g.title: f1__next_affected_story__1
g.text: A story's services stay inside the sorted union of the services of the seeds it covers.

g.title: f1__plan_edit__0
g.text: Plan an edit to epic `{{ workhorse_var('snapshot').epic }}`

g.title: f1__plan_edit__1
g.text: The open records of every repository, one line each under a header, for the planner to read.

g.title: f1__validate_plan__0
g.text: Reject an unsafe projected graph before any Ostler mutation runs.

g.title: f1__refine_plan__0
g.text: Refine an invalid epic edit plan

g.title: f1__refine_plan__1
g.text: The open records of every repository, one line each under a header, for the planner to read.

g.title: f1__rewrite_epic__1
g.text: Check the model-authored epic prose without re-parsing Ostler-owned graph metadata.

g.title: f1__rewrite_epic__2
g.text: Prove disk matches the approved graph and unaffected story bodies remain byte-stable.

g.title: f1__rewrite_epic__2->f1__rewrite_epic__0
g.text: blocked or out of reworks / the epic has findings

g.title: f2__start__0
g.text: Validate the requested story operation and name its parent epic and binding outcome.

g.title: f3__start__1
g.text: Validate an ordered, non-empty epic list without accepting prose, seeds, or stories.

g.title: f3__start__1->f3____end
g.text: the PM passed the split / the split stayed blocked

g.title: f4__author_epic__1
g.text: Apply the main worklist's documented-epic evidence to one explicit epic.

g.title: f4__author_epic__1->f4____end
g.text: the epic validates / out of budget

g.title: f5__start__0->f5____end
g.text: the split passed or stayed blocked

g.title: f6__start__0
g.text: Resolve exactly ``epic/story`` and give its document every required section it lacks.

g.title: f6__design_mockup__0
g.text: Design a mockup for a new screen: `{{ workhorse_var('story_slug') }}`

g.title: f6__story_feedback__0
g.text: Poll the operator's run-scoped inbox for un-consumed feedback.

g.title: f6__start__1
g.text: A story needs a mockup exactly when one of its services is a UI book.

g.title: f6__start__1->f6__design_mockup__0
g.text: the story changes a UI service

g.title: f7__close__0
g.text: Can the coder engine actually walk what this run produced?

g.title: f7__close__1
g.text: Prove the milestone lists its epics by id, and that it, they and their stories meet the authoring contract.

g.title: f7__close__2
g.text: Advance one validated milestone from approved to authored, idempotently.

g.title: f7__close__3
g.text: Commit the epic/story docs this run wrote, in the one repo it wrote them in.

g.title: f7__verify__0
g.text: Scope this run silently dropped, measured against the epics as they stood when it started.

g.title: f7__start->f7__verify__0
g.text: operator mode is auto or human

g.title: f7__verify__1
g.text: `ostler doctor` over the whole graph, as a blocking gate.

g.title: f7__verify__2
g.text: Prove the milestone lists its epics by id, and that it, they and their stories meet the authoring contract.

g.title: f7__verify__2->f7__verify__0
g.text: parked for the operator / the check holds

g.title: f8__write__0
g.text: Split one milestone into epic skeletons

g.title: f8__check__0
g.text: The bare-minimum story contract, checked deterministically.

g.title: f8__check__1
g.text: Does every seed the story claims belong to its epic?

g.title: f8__check__2
g.text: Validate an ordered, non-empty epic list without accepting prose, seeds, or stories.

g.title: f8__check__3
g.text: A story's services stay inside the sorted union of the services of the seeds it covers.

g.title: f8__check__4
g.text: Every seed covered by a story, the story graph acyclic, every story file present.

g.title: f8__review__0->f8____end
g.text: out of budget / the PM passed it

g.title: f8__rework__4
g.text: Append this attempt's failure to the story's attempts ledger, and read it back.

g.title: f9__review__0
g.text: Review as the product manager: {{ workhorse_var('stage') }}

g.title: f9__review__1
g.text: Review as the product manager: {{ workhorse_var('stage') }}

g.title: f9__review__2
g.text: Bind a passing review to the exact bytes it judged, for the stages whose output is a durable file.

g.title: f10__start__0
g.text: Answer a writer's question as the product manager

g.title: f10__record_human__0
g.text: Record one answered question in `grills/pm.md`, which only ever grows.

g.title: f10__start__1
g.text: Record one answered question in `grills/pm.md`, which only ever grows.

g.title: legend_c->legend_d
g.text: await: parked on an operator gate

g.title: legend_handoff
g.text: run to its END, then back here
